title: A Machine for the Terminal
author: Marguerite Iversen
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
